criterion: M2 exit criterion 9 (ROADMAP.md): the isometric occlusion fade on the GPU
setup: A tilemap item takes fade: { cells, to, layers }. cells is fadeMask (web/world/iso.mjs) for a target cell; a faded layer's pixels in cell i draw at opacity 1 - cells[i] * (1 - to). tilesRef (web/world/tiles_ref.mjs) applies the same rule on the CPU.

match.what: a 10 x 10 isometric map with a ground layer and a wall layer (walls on a seeded set of cells), the target behind a row of walls, at scales 1 and 2
match.bound: every channel within 2^-11 (half-float precision), the same bound as the tile pass

effect.bound: at least 100 pixels differ by more than 0.05 from the faded frame, and every such pixel lies in a cell with cells[i] > 0
effect.why: a fade that does nothing, or fades the wrong cells, would pass the match check if the twin shared the fault; this check ties the change to the mask

does_not_prove: That the fade reads well to a player, or behaviour for sprites (the fade covers tile layers only).
